findings.defect: The pause uses two consecutive ellipsis characters, a formatting pattern repeated throughout the packet, instead of the required single ellipsis character.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules require the single ellipsis character. All other doubled ellipses in chapters 280–284 should be normalized in the same way.

findings.defect: The phone UI sender label is unnecessarily enclosed in square brackets, contrary to the packet’s UI-formatting rule and the later rendering of the same sender.
findings.rationale: The later message panel already presents the sender as a bold heading without brackets, so this change makes the UI formatting consistent.

findings.current: Listening to their footsteps recede, I curled up the corners of my mouth.
findings.defect: “Curled up the corners of my mouth” is an unnatural English collocation.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the physical expression and Taekyung’s amused reaction while reading naturally in contemporary English.
findings.replacement: Listening to their footsteps recede, I curled the corners of my mouth upward.
findings.source: Chapter 282, opening negotiation in Jihoon’s office

findings.defect: The Melona footnote repeats the identical explanation already supplied at the term’s first occurrence in chapter 281.
findings.rationale: The footnote rules prohibit repeating a definition unnecessarily. The now-unused chapter 282 footnote definition should also be removed.

findings.current: As I listened to his good-natured smile and his soft words delivered like a joke, I thought:
findings.defect: The narration incorrectly says Taekyung listened to a smile, producing a category error and awkward phrasing.
findings.rationale: The replacement assigns the appropriate sense to each detail and preserves Lee Jungryong’s deliberately approachable presentation.
findings.replacement: As I watched his good-natured smile and listened to his soft, joking words, I thought:

findings.current: Taekyung defeated Myeongdong Guild Team 1, occupied Jihoon's office, and currently holds Park Tae Seop and Park Jihoon at knifepoint.
findings.defect: The active state stops before the end of chapter 284. Taekyung has released Park Tae Seop, mutilated and thrown down Jihoon, and Jihoon is now in Lee Jungryong’s arms.
findings.rationale: Active continuity must describe the endpoint of the reviewed packet rather than an earlier stage of the confrontation.
findings.replacement: Taekyung defeated Myeongdong Guild Team 1 and occupied Jihoon's office; after confronting Lee Jungryong, he released Park Tae Seop and mutilated Park Jihoon before throwing Jihoon down for Lee to retrieve.

findings.current: Lee Jungryong is a Supreme Peak master with qi control and palm technique comparable to the Yin-Yang Twin Devils.
findings.defect: The state drops the chapter-ending hook that Lee recognized Taekyung’s internal-energy method and questioned how someone so young knew it.
findings.rationale: Lee’s explicit recognition suggests knowledge beyond ordinary modern Hunter practice and is an unresolved continuity hook needed by subsequent chapters.
findings.replacement: Lee Jungryong is a Supreme Peak master with qi control and palm technique comparable to the Yin-Yang Twin Devils; he recognized Taekyung's internal-energy method and questioned how someone so young knew it.
findings.source: Durable state, active_continuity entry describing Lee Jungryong’s martial ability

summary: The reading copies are coherent and preserve the major confrontation, but the durable state is stale at the chapter 284 endpoint and omits Lee Jungryong’s recognition of Taekyung’s internal-energy method. Several minor prose and formatting issues are also actionable.
